_doc: Caption script for the neutral wiggle-that-diagram demo: how a pizza order travels from the app to the kitchen to the door. Every name, number and address is made up. Format: plugins/wiggle-that-diagram/skills/wiggle-that-diagram/scripts/common/beats.example.json.

pizza.title: How a pizza order travels
pizza.alt: Animation in five steps. Sam orders one margherita in a phone app. The order prints as a ticket in the kitchen and the pizza goes into the oven. When the timer ends, a driver collects the box. The app shows the driver on a map. The driver hands the box over at 12 Elm Street, 25 minutes after the order.

beats.title: Sam orders
beats.caption: Sam taps Order in the pizza app: one margherita, to 12 Elm Street.

beats.title: Kitchen gets a ticket
beats.caption: The order prints as a ticket in the kitchen, and the pizza goes into the oven.

beats.title: Driver collects
beats.caption: When the oven timer ends, the box goes on the shelf and a driver collects it.

beats.title: Tracked on a map
beats.caption: The app follows the driver on a map, so Sam can watch the pizza get closer.

beats.title: At the door
beats.caption: The driver hands over the box at 12 Elm Street, 25 minutes after the tap.
